cold_start.fix: Bounded credential-only readiness checks before marking deployment ready; no managed-job retry

assumptions: No free-tier, credits, taxes or negotiated discounts included in planning models
Glue 5 standard, two G.1X workers; service execution seconds with a 60-second per-run floor
Athena successful DML rounded upward to decimal MB with 10 MB minimum; 1 TB = 10^12 bytes, conservative model
CodeBuild Linux small total wall minutes rounded upward, including provisioning/queue; billable compute may be lower
S3 ending-inventory snapshot held for the complete observed campaign duration, 730-hour month and decimal GB model
Retained shared Glue logs, requests, catalog, transfer and billing APIs use explicit allowances, not claimed complete metering
Cost Explorer tagged UnblendedCost remains estimated and can lag; a zero current-day value is not a free campaign
Planning thresholds are operator stop rules, not enforced AWS Budget caps

limits: Compact five-phase CLI and full historical domain are separate clean AWS deployments
Gold uses the shared tariff engine; independent unit expectations and full raw-index/interval SHA-256 complement it
Reference comparisons cover the declared operational projection; no new reference-business-correction campaign
Invalid records are valid JSON with ten controlled contract/type/value violations; malformed JSON syntax is not covered
Quarantine replay proves exact logical contents, not physical snapshot stability; accepted ten-table metadata stays stable
Schema version 2 is rejected, not migrated; no production SLA, tenant isolation or concurrent-writer certification
Cost Explorer is estimated/delayed; metered planning models and unmetered allowances are not a settled invoice
Persistent controls, versioned state and reviewed/shared job logs remain; no continuously running data-processing cluster
privacy: Synthetic counts, fingerprints, scoped checks and reviewed project costs only; raw data rows, pointers, credentials, plans, state, queries and logs remain private
scope: Final on-demand V1 demonstration acceptance, not production certification
